settings.heading: Already ordered
settings.body: Include your order number and we can skip three emails. If you need to change a gift message or a delivery address, tell us within the hour and we can usually catch it before the box is packed.

settings.heading: Ten boxes or more
settings.body: Email before you order so we can confirm we can pack them in the time you need. For a run that size we can use a plain band instead of a ribbon, and print the cards rather than write them out if the message is the same on all of them.

settings.heading: Press and stockists
settings.body: Same address. Tell us what you need and when you need it by.

settings.heading: Talk to a person
settings.intro: We are a small studio, so an email reaches somebody who has actually packed the box you are asking about. No chatbot.
